core_obligations: The homotopy family (proof lines 6627-6638): condition (1) forces h_{n,0} = a star b_n and h_{n,n+1} = a_n star b; the choice h_{n,i} = a_{i-1} star b_{n-i} for 1 <= i <= n (with a = a_{-1}, b = b_{-1}) covers 0 <= i <= n+1.

Face relations, conditions (2) and (3) (lines 6640-6683): for i > j, d^n_j is rewritten as d^{i-1}_j star 1_{n-i+1}, and both sides of the required identity reduce to (a_{i-2} circ d^{i-1}_j) star b_{n-i} using the compatibility of the a_m with the augmentations; for i <= j the left side rewrites via 1_i star d^{n-i}_{j-i} and both sides agree similarly; the corresponding identities for G' circ X circ F' are analogous.

Degeneracy relations, conditions (4) and (5) (lines 6684-6748): for i > j, s^n_j = s^{i-1}_j star 1_{n-i+1} and both sides reduce to (a_i circ s^{i-1}_j) star b_{n-i}; for i <= j both sides evaluate to a_{i-1} star (s^{n-i}_{j-i} circ b_{n-i}) by the same arguments.
proof_roadmap: Fix the forced endpoint values h_{n,0}, h_{n,n+1} and interpolate by a_{i-1} star b_{n-i}.
Verify the two face conditions by sliding d across the star factors.
Verify the two degeneracy conditions the same way with s.

H2: formal but complete double-star calculus.
